articles.summary: MARLBOROUGH, Mass., Oct. 05, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) - IPG Photonics today announced that from October 6 th though October 8 th , 2026, IPG Defense will participate in Land Forces 2026 in Perth, Australia to showcase CROSSBOW™ High-Energy Laser (HEL) Systems. This key industry event provides a platform to forge strategic alliances and collaborate to shape the future of the global aerospace and defense market. IPG Defense Products at Land Forces 2026 In the IPG Defense booth, visitors will experience both the previously released CROSSBOW MINI and the first addition to the new CROSSBOW SE product line, the CROSSBOW SE1 8 kW. Multiple systems will be on display in a typical layered defense arrangement to showcase several deployment scenarios first-hand. Both products share the same scalable architecture and easily integrate with available radar and C2 systems. articles.summary: MARLBOROUGH, Mass., Oct. 20, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) - IPG Photonics Corporation (Nasdaq: IPGP) will release its third quarter 2026 financial results before the market opens on Tuesday, November 3, 2026. The Company will hold a conference call to review these results at 10:00 a.m. ET on the same day. To access the call, please dial 877-407-6184 in the United States or 201-389-0877 internationally. A live webcast of the call will also be available and archived in the investor relations section of the Company’s website at investor.ipgphotonics.com . About IPG Photonics Corporation Innovation is at the heart of IPG Photonics. As a global leader in laser technology, we apply light to transform the world. From manufacturing to medical and beyond, our breakthrough laser solutions power our customers’ success and expand what's possible. Discover more at www.ipgphotonics.com .
